IGUI_SH_Info1_squad: Ferryman Three-Two puts five operators down near you. They follow you and fight the infected, who cannot kill them. One you hit yourself is pulled out at once.
IGUI_SH_Info2_squad: When their time is up, or you recall them, the helicopter comes back and flies them out. Needs the Bandits mod.
IGUI_SH_Hint_Squad: Diamond: the team follows and covers you.
IGUI_SH_Hint_SquadRally: Regrouped: the team stays right beside you.
IGUI_SHW_Tip_Rally: The operators close in right around you. Good in tight spaces and indoors.
IGUI_SHW_Tip_Spread: The operators spread back out into the diamond (point, flanks, rear).
